scope: Read-only GNSS retry log attribution, idle/voice fixture and finally restoration, plus the added final source PID/executable/TID/fwlog/ready checks. No product audit, ADB, actual probe rerun, or production changes.

historical_items.description: The initial idle snapshot did not survive the system restart of the selected voice interactor; GPS had started before the new probe registered.
historical_items.resolution: The revision empties and checks the voice binding, observes no active implementation, and checks binding/GPS again immediately before launch. The latest real preparation found a reappeared binding and rejected before launching.

historical_items.description: The initial finally skipped HOME when Search restoration raised.
historical_items.resolution: The revision independently attempts recognizer setting, interactor setting, Search availability, and HOME; errors are aggregated and fail the fixture. Injected failures verified later restoration attempts remain reachable.

actual_runtime_observations.failure: voice_interaction_service became nonempty again at the final prelaunch guard

limits: No actual GNSS acceptance PASS is established by this review. Positive callback fixtures are explicitly synthetic; the retained real runs are expected to reject.

Restoration establishes the recorded secure-setting values, Search availability/stopped=false where required, and HOME command completion. It does not reconstruct the earlier process identities or exact location subscriptions.
Final source-process checks were reviewed and tested with mocked shell responses. The final handset attestation had not been executed in the retained review inputs.

The log-prefix check rejects changed/wrapped retained records and requires every newly appended probe record to match the newly observed PID. This is not a generic native-log clock or arbitrary process-reuse proof.

The initial harness run had two synthetic fixtures incorrectly alter old summary text; their expected success failed at the unchanged prefix guard. The corrected fixtures preserve old history and the final 25-case run passes.
